UmbracoCommunityContentAuditConfiguratio.description: Settings controlling how audits are performed.

RespectRobotsTxt.description: Whether to respect robots.txt when crawling.

UseUmbracoContentIndex.description: Whether to use the Umbraco content index for discovery.

UseSitemapXml.description: Whether to use sitemap.xml for discovery.

SitemapUrl.description: Optional absolute URL to a sitemap to crawl.

MaxConcurrentCrawls.description: Maximum number of concurrent crawl tasks.

BaseUrl.description: Base URL for the site under audit.

MaxCrawlDurationMinutes.description: Maximum duration in minutes for a crawl operation. Set to 0 for no limit.

UseIncrementalCrawl.description: Whether to use incremental crawls (only re-crawl changed pages).

ExcludePatterns.description:
URL patterns to exclude from crawling. Supports wildcards (* and **).
Examples: "/admin/*", "*/api/**", "*.pdf"

IncludePatterns.description:
URL patterns to include in crawling. If specified, only matching URLs will be crawled.
Supports wildcards (* and **). Examples: "/blog/*", "/products/**"

CrawlDelayMs.description:
Delay in milliseconds between crawl requests. Set to 0 for no delay.
This can be overridden by robots.txt Crawl-delay directive if RespectRobotsTxt is enabled.

MaxCrawlDepth.description: Maximum crawl depth from the starting URL. Set to 0 for unlimited depth.

PageTimeoutMs.description:
Timeout in milliseconds for each page navigation. Applies to both Playwright and HttpClient fallback.
Set to 0 to use Playwright's default timeout (30 seconds).

ExternalRequestDelayMs.description:
Minimum delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests to the same external domain.
Applies to HEAD requests for external links and resources. Set to 0 to disable.

AutoEnrichAfterCrawl.description:
When true, automatically runs Playwright-based performance enrichment after each crawl completes.
When false (default), enrichment must be triggered manually via the backoffice or API.
